# Fix Bug Prompt

Act as a senior engineer debugging ExpenseLedger.

1. Inspect the exact current implementation before changing anything.
2. Trace the issue from UI to API/domain/data flow as applicable.
3. Reuse existing components, services and CSS instead of inventing alternatives.
4. Identify the root cause, not just the visible symptom.
5. Minimize the change surface while preserving architecture.
6. Verify Light/Dark behavior, validation, accessibility and responsive behavior when UI is involved.
7. Preserve Clean Architecture, CQRS, MediatR, Redis and existing contracts.
8. When code is requested, return complete replacement files with exact paths; never provide a patch unless explicitly requested.
